Loading required package: Matrix
[1] ‘2.0.1’
function (object, correlation = TRUE, sigm = sigma(object), use.hessian = NULL, 
    full = FALSE, noScale = NULL, ...) 
{
    if (full) 
        return(vcov_full(object, sigm))
    hess.avail <- (!is.null(h <- object@optinfo$derivs$Hessian) && 
        nrow(h) > (ntheta <- length(object@theta)))
    if (is.null(use.hessian)) 
        use.hessian <- hess.avail
    if (use.hessian && !hess.avail) 
        stop(shQuote("use.hessian"), "=TRUE specified, ", "but Hessian is unavailable")
    calc.vcov.hess <- function(h) {
        h <- tryCatch(solve(h), error = function(e) matrix(NA, 
            nrow = nrow(h), ncol = ncol(h)))
        i <- -seq_len(ntheta)
        h <- h[i, i]
        forceSymmetric(h + t(h))
    }
    V <- sigm^2 * object@pp$unsc()
    if (hess.avail) {
        V.hess <- calc.vcov.hess(h)
        bad.V.hess <- any(is.na(V.hess))
        if (!bad.V.hess) {
            e.hess <- eigen(V.hess, symmetric = TRUE, only.values = TRUE)$values
            if (min(e.hess) <= 0) 
                bad.V.hess <- TRUE
        }
    }
    if (!use.hessian && hess.avail) {
        var.hess.tol <- 1e-04
        if (!bad.V.hess && any(abs(V - V.hess) > var.hess.tol * 
            V.hess)) 
            warning("variance-covariance matrix computed ", "from finite-difference Hessian\nand ", 
                "from RX differ by >", var.hess.tol, ": ", "consider ", 
                shQuote("use.hessian=TRUE"))
    }
    if (use.hessian) {
        if (!bad.V.hess) {
            V <- V.hess
        }
        else {
            warning("variance-covariance matrix computed ", "from finite-difference Hessian is\n", 
                "not positive definite or contains NA values: falling back to ", 
                "var-cov estimated from RX")
        }
    }
    rr <- tryCatch(as(V, "dpoMatrix"), error = function(e) e)
    if (inherits(rr, "error")) {
        warning(gettextf("Computed variance-covariance matrix problem: %s;\nreturning NA matrix", 
            rr$message), domain = NA)
        rr <- matrix(NA, nrow(V), ncol(V))
    }
    nmsX <- colnames(object@pp$X)
    dimnames(rr) <- list(nmsX, nmsX)
    if (correlation) 
        rr@factors$correlation <- if (!is.na(sigm)) 
            as(rr, "corMatrix")
        else rr
    if (is.null(noScale) || (!is.null(noScale) && !noScale)) {
        if (!is.null(sc <- attr(object@pp$X, "scaled:scale"))) {
            ce <- attr(object@pp$X, "scaled:center")
            rr <- scale_vcov(rr, sc, ce)
        }
    }
    rr
}
